name: link-mender
description: Find each broken relative link in the Markdown files under docs/ and point it at the file's new place. Use after files under docs/ move or are renamed. Do not use for web links or images.
metadata:
  roles: implementer
  areas: rest
  sourcing: new

# Link mender

## Steps

1. List every relative link under docs/ whose target is missing. Check: each has its file and line.
2. Find the file's new path. Check: the new path exists.
